title: Mexico's 50% tariff wall: why India just started trade talks with Mexico
short: Mexico's tariff wall, and India's answer: a trade pact
dek: Since January, Mexico has charged up to 50% on goods from countries without a trade deal, including India. Cars are hit hardest. On 28 October, the two countries formally began talks on a preferential trade agreement.
card: Mexico raised duties on about 1,400 products to as much as 50%. India's car exports are in the firing line, and talks have just begun.
